'''Chicken Parmesan''' is a classic Italian dish, which is wonderful served over [[cookbook:pasta|pasta]] or on a [[Cookbook:Sandwiches|sandwich]]. This is a fairly simple recipe made mostly with ingredients already on hand.

==Ingredients==
* 6 [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken breast halves]], flattened to ½-inch thickness
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Flour|all purpose flour]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 1½ cups Italian seasoned [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|bread crumbs]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]] [[cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]], divided
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]], freshly-ground if possible
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* 1 jar (16 oz) [[Cookbook:Spaghetti Sauce|spaghetti sauce]] (or make it fresh)
* 1 package [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] [[cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]]

==Procedure==
# Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F (175°C).
# Mix the breadcrumbs, salt, black pepper, and half the Parmesan cheese in a [[Cookbook:Mixing Bowl|mixing bowl]].
# [[cookbook:Beat|Beat]] the eggs in a small bowl.
# On the [[Cookbook:Cooktop|stove]], heat olive oil in a large [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] over medium-high heat
# Take each chicken breast and dip it into the flour, then into the eggs, then into the breadcrumb mixture. Make sure to coat it thoroughly.
# [[cookbook:Pan fry|Pan fry]] the chicken breasts lightly in the olive oil until brown on both sides. You do not need to cook them through, just [[cookbook:brown|brown]] them. Once brown, the breadcrumbs should stick to the outside.
# Pour half a jar of pasta sauce into a shallow [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]], then lay the chicken out in the pan. Pour the rest of the sauce on top.
# Sprinkle the remaining grated Parmesan cheese over the chicken.
# Place the dish in the oven and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] for 30 minutes at 350°F (175°C).
# Remove and add a slice of mozzarella cheese to each chicken breast.
# Return to the oven for 10 more minutes to melt the mozzarella.
# Serve with [[cookbook:pasta|pasta]].
